purpose: Audited native Shared Storage library reuse; no remote deployment or lifecycle agent. Upstream reference remains unmodified.
license: Original root GPLv3 notice copied verbatim to LICENSE. Original engine manifests' MIT notices are preserved; their conflict requires owner/license review. New bridge and native adaptation code is GPL-3.0-only; no claim that the whole snapshot is MIT.
adaptations: Cargo.toml and crates/noland-state-agent/Cargo.toml: omit the lifecycle-agent member/source, disable automatic executable discovery and remove the remote state-agent binary target. The initial library-only fork also omits the remote README.md, rust-toolchain.toml, prebuilt/.gitkeep, scripts/{bootstrap-remote.sh,install-lifecycle-agent.sh,install-state-agent.sh} and systemd/{noland-lifecycle-agent.service,noland-state-agent.service}. QuickSave never runs provisioning, SSH, sockets, systemd or lifecycle agents.
LICENSE: preserve the pinned repository's original GPLv3 document verbatim, while retaining all existing package/source notices and documenting the root/engine-manifest license conflict.

crates/noland-observer/{Cargo.toml,build.rs,src/bpf.rs} and crates/noland-state-agent/Cargo.toml: add explicit native-host BPF-disabled library mode; default upstream Linux observer remains unchanged, native capture uses full exact-root reconciliation instead of claiming kernel observer authority.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/{lib.rs,native_host.rs,reconcile.rs} and crates/noland-snapshot/src/source.rs: native-owned paths, real pinned approved software/root identities, exact parent-leaf allowlists without sibling enumeration, QuickSave exclusions, stable logical root/file IDs, bounded reconciliation and no inferred Linux HOME/application discovery.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/{backup.rs,rpc_handler.rs,rpc_handler/retry.rs}: extend the existing keyed source submission/retry identity with exact native file/root/destination selection; constrain candidates, inherited files and tombstones; reuse actual source capture/FastCDC/zstd/crypto/packs/adaptive streaming/journals/cancellation/admission/receipt routines.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/{lib.rs,backup.rs}: add converge_complete_backups policy defaulting upstream-true; the QuickSave bridge sets false and gates only the two converge_application calls, preserving additive history and explicit deletion safety.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/{lib.rs,restore.rs,rpc_handler.rs}, crates/noland-state-core/src/native_layout.rs and crates/noland-restore/src/{lib.rs,native.rs,native/**,pipeline.rs,leaf.rs,journal.rs}: frozen native restore controls, exact mappings/conflicts, separately acknowledged replacement, authenticated ownership journals and explicit local-only recovery. Native boot NEVER replays restore paths. New authenticated layout descriptors can reconstruct actual package directories/resources/relative links within the user-picked destination, without trusting original absolute source hints or claiming Runnable readiness. Legacy layouts remain files-only; signature/dependency/platform acceptance remains separate.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/rpc_handler/deletion.rs: preserve actual PrepareDeletion/StartDeletion and API22 authenticated FullDeletionPlans, with separately checked/persisted native dependency acknowledgement across retry/reattachment.

crates/noland-storage/{Cargo.toml,src/lib.rs,src/native_runtime.rs,src/rclone.rs,src/rclone/fetch.rs,src/rclone/upload.rs}: native absolute installed-tool pinning/revalidation, clean process environment, no password prompts, session-private scratch staging, bounded control output and no raw native provider errors. No PATH injection, installer execution, secret argv or new cloud format.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/{native_capture.rs,native_host.rs,backup.rs,backup/**,session_storage.rs}: page original frozen native metadata through Rust-only owners; mint receipts only from actual stable source capture/prepared manifests, not tracker-predicted hashes. Bind canonical product and installation-instance identities, complete stamps, roles, v3 root kind/basename fingerprints, uncertainty epochs, exact full-scope omission grants and original baseline lineage. Support authenticated empty roots/additive tombstones and complete manifests with unchanged-file/chunk reuse. Revalidate authority at actual COMMITTED/catalog publication, never on content-free status polls; no automatic deletion/retirement.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/native_capture_resume.rs: reattach only independently device-authenticated original Tracker frames/receipt sidecars and original source submission/AEAD proof checkpoints. Reconstruct real native root owners and original receipts without source-content recapture, new snapshot identities or repository-key-only authorization. Missing, changed or unauthenticated original work fails explicitly. Actual committed completion remains a separate mandatory verification barrier.

Cargo.lock, crates/noland-state-db/{Cargo.toml,src/store.rs,src/native.rs} and crates/noland-state-agent/src/{lib.rs,session_storage/tests.rs}: add Unix native-only private DB admission with pinned directory/main/sidecar handles, single-link owned 0600 regular-file checks before SQLite I/O, SQLITE_OPEN_NOFOLLOW on main writer/readers, and verified WAL/FULL synchronous native shadow receipts. Recheck native files/root identity during open and DB lock admission; reject insecure existing files without global umask/chmod repair. Native dependency on the existing no-follow snapshot handle library is Unix-only; the fork lock records that existing-library edge. Default non-native SQLite opens/NORMAL policy remain unchanged. This is not a custom VFS and does not close every hostile concurrent SQLite sidecar namespace race; private single-owner directory confinement and explicit failure gates remain required.

crates/noland-restore/src/{pipeline.rs,pipeline/accounting_tests.rs}: separate native partial precreation/open ownership from first accepted assembly placement. Maintain unfinished-file count and received-byte sum with checked, all-or-error transitions and require zero residual counters at successful completion; never saturate away an inconsistent state. Isolated native/non-native regressions cover empty and one-chunk files, shared-chunk fanout across handle/hasher budgets, retry deduplication, zero-byte placements, counter overflow and inconsistent-counter rejection. Existing bounded handles/hashers/verification/publication buffers and non-native restore semantics are preserved.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/lib.rs, crates/noland-storage/src/rclone.rs and crates/noland-snapshot/src/source.rs: native startup retains untrusted legacy credential artifacts rather than automatically sweeping them. Live session guards retain their real directory handle/identity, exclusively create new credential files, and unlink only known leaves with pinned-handle/quarantine checks. Cleanup never overwrites potentially hardlinked outside data or recursively removes unknown entries/replacement directories. Legacy startup cleanup rejects a symlinked storage root before enumeration. Secure SSD erasure is not claimed.

crates/noland-storage/src/{native_credentials.rs,native_runtime.rs,rclone.rs,rclone/**}: operation-bound private OAuth refresh/CAS callbacks, explicit session finish/checkpoint, retained authenticated recovery artifacts and shared approved transfer policy. Real provider/vault acceptance remains unverified; no secret enters progress, durable selections, argv or renderer DTOs.

crates/noland-snapshot/src/{metadata.rs,source.rs,native_metadata.rs,windows.rs}, crates/noland-cas/src/{native.rs,capture.rs,lib.rs} and crates/noland-pack/src/lib.rs: actual native handle identities, full Windows file IDs/change times, private no-follow filesystem boundaries, shared GC locks, hard-link leases and no-replace publication. Preserve FastCDC/BLAKE3, compression formats, bounded capture/pack streaming and integrity checks. Windows runtime acceptance remains pending.

crates/noland-state-db/src/{windows.rs,store.rs,lib.rs}, its Cargo.toml, and crates/noland-state-core/src/disk.rs: protected Windows SQLite VFS admission, pinned native main/sidecar identities, WAL/FULL durability checks, and quota-aware volume-GUID disk admission. One explicit Windows-only dependency on ../../../crates/quicksave-platform reuses the audited local handle/ACL boundary; no other dependency may escape the active fork.

crates/noland-state-agent/src/{native_deletion.rs,deletion.rs,session_storage.rs,rpc_handler.rs}: native projection of the actual frozen full deletion plan, exact affected/dependent commit identities and per-mutation authority checks. Native new submissions honor explicit compatible capture mode/performance policy instead of upgrading selected files to complete applications.

crates/noland-testkit/tests/native_optimized_pipeline.rs: bounded isolated tests and opt-in benchmark over actual source LocalStorage/capture/FastCDC/CAS/packs/commit/restore. Record read/hash/reuse/pack/counter/durability scopes, including explicitly simulated adaptive-limit feedback. No fixture uses live provider accounts, OS vault entries, production data, original collectors, remote lifecycle or downloaded executables.

crates/noland-restore/src/{windows.rs,windows/**,native/windows_contract.rs,native/windows_contract/**,native/reconstruction.rs}: portable shared restore scheduling/verification with real OS-specific no-follow publication, ownership journals, rollback and metadata. Unix v1 journal serialization remains compatible; Windows v2 frames retain full IDs/change time/security state without fabricated Unix UID/GID/modes. Manual-leaf roots need an authenticated exact metadataScope/allowlist digest, not null-as-whole-root permission. Existing unsupported legacy Windows mutations fail explicitly.

adaptation_details.change: Retain only library workspace members; exclude and omit the lifecycle agent. Disable autobins and remove the explicit remote state-agent binary target. Original remote main.rs remains reference source but is not a Cargo executable target. No socket server, SSH, provisioning, systemd or lifecycle process is executed by QuickSave.
Copy the pinned repository's original GNU GPL version 3 notice verbatim; preserve existing per-package/source notices.

Add an explicit native-host feature that disables Linux BPF object compilation/loader authority only for the native library path. Default upstream Linux observation remains unchanged. Native capture always reconciles exact approved roots; the native watcher is a hint, never kernel-observer proof.

Add explicit native-host configuration, pinned native file/directory identities and exact software/root bindings, persistent-identity validation, individual-file/manual-parent allowlists, QuickSave-internal exclusions, and bounded inventory. Native mode does not discover Linux app/home ownership or bootstrap procfs sessions. Expose the existing no-follow directory opener. Reuse source reconciliation/capture generation guards.

Bind exact native logical file selections, root fingerprints and native destinations into existing keyed submission/retry identity. Filter candidates, inherited files and tombstones before capture. Native custom-root values retain stable tracker-compatible root/file IDs. Native explicit file authority replaces Linux pathname heuristics only; actual FastCDC, zstd, authenticated NLNE/NLZ1/NLPK packs, bounded adaptive streaming, stable-file identities, durable prepared revisions, journals, cancellation, repository admission and receipts are reused unchanged. Do not describe file-copy capture as an application-atomic snapshot.

Add converge_complete_backups policy (upstream default true); the QuickSave bridge explicitly sets false, gating only the two post-backup converge_application calls. Existing generation/commit guards and explicit FullDeletionPlan protocol are not weakened; QuickSave history remains additive.

Native downloads use authenticated frozen controls and exact destination root maps, ignoring absolute Linux/source executable hints. Strict native relative links do not inherit generic Linux absolute-link permissions. Conflicts, replacement and tombstones require separate exact acknowledgement. Native ownership journals authenticate operation/attempt/root/native entry identities before publication, rollback or explicit local recovery; foreign/unverifiable artifacts are retained. Clean completion permits authenticated metadata-only receipts, never retained plaintext or an unsigned journal. New package layout reconstruction remains non-runnable until real signature/dependency/platform acceptance; legacy manifests remain files-only. Native boot never automatically replays restore paths.

Preserve actual PrepareDeletion/StartDeletion, API22 admission and authenticated full frozen dependency deletion. Require and persist separate native dependency acknowledgement so retry/reattachment uses only the originally acknowledged plan.

Add native installed-rclone executable pinning and identity revalidation, cleared inherited environment, no password prompts, native session-owned private scratch staging, bounded control output and sanitized native provider errors. The bridge separately preflights the exact absolute installed tool/version >=1.76 and actual listing/transfer flags. No PATH injection, downloads/installers, secret argv or raw provider logs are added; default upstream executable selection is retained unless native mode installs the verified pin.

Native-host boot selects a private Unix DB opener: pin an owned single-link 0600 main file under an owned pinned 0700 directory; inspect existing WAL/SHM/journal files through no-follow native handles before SQLite I/O; require SQLITE_OPEN_NOFOLLOW writer/readers and verified WAL/FULL synchronous receipts. Check root/main/sidecar identities across initialization and DB lock admission. Reject insecure existing files without permission repair or process-global umask changes. SQLite still manages named sidecars; this is not a custom VFS or a complete hostile namespace-race solution. Preserve the default non-native opener and NORMAL policy. The fork lock records only existing libc/snapshot dependency edges.

Native restore partials are already opened before streaming; do not use the opened flag to infer first assembly admission. Track that transition independently, using checked count/byte updates committed only after every arithmetic check succeeds. Unfinished metrics equal the count/sum of assembly-started pending files, not open descriptors or plaintext memory; completion requires both counters to return to zero. Add synthetic native/non-native integration and pure counter edge regressions without increasing buffer/hasher/handle budgets or weakening retained-artifact/overwrite safety.

Skip legacy credential sweeping in native startup. Pin each live execution directory before credential creation, create guarded leaves exclusively, and remove only known leaves through owned directory handles and identity-checked quarantine/unlink. Never zero an inode that may be hardlinked outside the session, recurse through unknown entries, or clean a replacement directory. Expose the existing no-follow child constructor for this owned-handle use. Add synthetic hardlink, replaced-directory, unknown-entry and storage-symlink tests. Retain unauthenticated crash artifacts; do not claim secure erasure or accepted automatic recovery.

verification.builds: Parent owns all serialized shared-target Cargo builds/tests. No agent Cargo builds or live-provider acceptance claims.
verification.fixtures: Bridge tests use only synthetic isolated native roots and the actual source LocalStorage engine. The separately marked installed-rclone local-provider fixture is ignored unless an independently installed rclone >=1.76 is available; absence is explicit, not a fake provider success.
verification.platforms: macOS host compilation/tests do not establish Linux, Windows or packaged application acceptance. Windows native engine and platform-test GNU target compilation passed at recorded checkpoints; service/catalog/observation integration and native runtime acceptance are separate gates. No live No Land state or real provider/vault entries were used.
verification.measured_native_fixture: artifacts/native-shared-storage-benchmark.json records a passed 64 MiB / 1000-file actual-source isolated filesystem-provider workload. It is not live-provider throughput, physical-read/RSS measurement, power-loss, packaging or cross-platform acceptance.
